_contract.why: Hand-authored from CONTRACT.md v1.0 before CallCenterWeb/* exists. Shape is contract; values are illustrative. Replaced by a real capture at first integration (CONTRACT.md §11).
_contract.scenario: The atomic rebind refusal — a line that no longer prices at the new store. The canonical business-outcome envelope this repo's ApiError maps to kind:'business'.

preview._note: The preview (step 1) already showed it — unpriceableLines is non-empty there, so the console can refuse before the agent commits. This fixture is the commit path, for the case where the basket changed between preview and commit.

response.message: This order cannot move to Riyadh — Al Yasmin: 1 item has no price there.

errors.errorMessage: Compounded cream 50g (300921) has no price at plant 1204.

_notes: ATOMIC: nothing is persisted. The engine instance that attempted the rebind is discarded, never saved (129's documented discard-never-save).
The plant does NOT move. The agent voids the offending line and retries — the console names the line, which is why unpriceableLines rides both the preview and the refusal.

🚩 core/api.ts maps a non-2xx-with-envelope to ApiError(kind:'business') carrying message + errors[0].errorCode, but it DROPS body.data (src/core/api.ts:110-120). The console therefore reads the offending lines off the PREVIEW it already holds, not off this refusal — which is exactly why every 'are you sure' rides the success path instead (CONTRACT.md §5). A future core change could surface data; nothing here depends on it.
message is server-supplied and passed through as data — no i18n key needed for it. Every label AROUND it needs one (.claude/rules/i18n-zero-literal.md).
